name: Mui Ne resort living
summary: One long resort road with wind, kitesurf schools, and Cham-style beach hotels.
body: The strip is spread along Nguyen Dinh Chieu and side streets. Distances feel short on a map and long in the heat.
Anantara and The Anam are named on their sites but have no licensed resort photo in this guide yet, so they are not listed below.

properties.name: Pandanus Resort
properties.summary: Cham-style beachfront on Nguyen Huu Tho at the resort end of the strip.

properties.name: Asteria Mui Ne Resort
properties.summary: Large beachfront pool and arena stage on Xuan Thuy facing the East Sea.

seoTitle: Mui Ne resorts — Pandanus and Asteria on the strip
seoDescription: Sourced premium resorts on the Mui Ne strip: Pandanus Resort and Asteria Mui Ne.
